verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that agents can be managed through the ElevenLabs API, alongside the dashboard, an Agents CLI and a hosted MCP server. The quickstart walks through creating an agent via the API. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) reinforce programmatic access. Missing for 10: API reference detail in evidence (endpoint coverage, API-key auth, SDKs, rate limits) and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
